title: Chuyên đề thực tế - Toán kinh tế

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Summarize relevant economic and financial knowledge.
Systematize specialized knowledge and combine tools for analysis to solve economic and financial problems.
Identify appropriate IT tools for solving economic and financial problems and determine additional knowledge needed.
Recognize economic relationships through practical environments and understand methods to solve economic and financial issues.
Identify practical issues that can be addressed using learned knowledge.
Explain the urgency of the problem, set research goals and questions.
Review previous research and update related tools to address the problem.
Apply learned knowledge and self-taught skills to calculate and solve economic and financial problems.
Analyze results, report findings, evaluate outcomes, and propose policies for related issues.
Present findings, discuss with peers, and complete reports.
Report findings, defend opinions before a panel.
